definitions.gloss: to bend, to curve, to make crooked
definitions.explanation: To change something from straight to curved or angled.
To alter or misrepresent information; to bend the rules.

notes:
{曲|ま}げる is a transitive verb meaning to bend something or to distort.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pair: {曲|ま}がる (intransitive - to bend, to turn)
- Pattern: Xを{曲|ま}げる

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腰|こし}を{曲|ま}げる (bend one's back)
- {膝|ひざ}を{曲|ま}げる (bend one's knee)
- {角|かど}を{曲|ま}げる (turn a corner) *more commonly uses {曲|ま}がる

FIGURATIVE USAGE:
- {事実|じじつ}を{曲|ま}げる (distort facts)
- {法律|ほうりつ}を{曲|ま}げる (bend the law)
- {意見|いけん}を{曲|ま}げない (not change one's opinion)
